text:
Maria: Heads up, starting canary for release v3.14 -> v3.15 on EU-west at 17:12 UTC. Will watch SLOs on /generate-stream and /embeddings.
DeployBot: canary start: release=v3.15, canary-nodes=2
DeployBot: metrics snapshot (canary-1): p95=220ms, 5xx=0.1%
DeployBot: metrics snapshot (canary-2): p95=1.8s, 5xx=2.2%  <-- alerting
Sam: That's a spike on canary-2 for /generate-stream. Anyone seeing error logs?
Neil: Yep, saw a few OOM-ish stack traces from runtime: "kvcache miss -> eviction -> worker restart". Might be perf regression in the new runtime config.
Ops-Liz: Which model variant is that canary hitting? v3.15 default is q8_0 + new batching config.
Maria: Canary-2 routed ~40% to dedicated eu-west pool where the larger model landed.
Reena: Would prefer pinning traffic back to v3.14 on that pool rather than full rollback. Pin is quicker and keeps other regions moving.
Sam: Agree. If pin keeps latency and errors normal we can continue rollout elsewhere. Can someone run the pin command?
Neil: Running: `deployctl pin --route /generate-stream --pool eu-west --version v3.14 --reason "p95/5xx spike on canary-2"`
DeployBot: pin applied: route=/generate-stream pool=eu-west version=v3.14 by=Neil
DeployBot: post-pin metrics (30s): canary-2 p95=210ms, 5xx=0.15%
Ops-Liz: Nice. Keep watch for a few minutes. Opened INC-4123 for follow-up.
Maria: I'll capture the release notes update: mention batching/quant changes, instruct SRE to add a canary alert for kvcache evictions.
Reena: Also recommend we add a temp rollback flag for future pushes to that pool until we root-cause.
Sam: Plan: 1) hold further shifts to eu-west 2) SRE triages OOM traces 3) Release team updates notes and backfill canary tests.
Maria: Thanks. If metrics stay stable let's mark rollout paused but not rolled back. Reassigning to Neil/Ops-Liz for the next 6h.
Neil: On it. I'll drop logs into INC-4123 and ping if I need a hotfix deploy.
DeployBot: canary end: status=paused (pin active).
